chapters.label: Live: the 2010 Asian final
chapters.text: Tashkent, twenty ten: the Asian Futsal Championship final. Iran beat the hosts, Uzbekistan, eight to three! In goal, number twelve: Mostafa Nazari. That year, he was named the best futsal goalkeeper in the world.

chapters.label: How he blocks (demo)
chapters.text: How he blocks: the shot comes from close, so there is no time to dive. He steps across into the line of the ball, drops low and makes a wall. Chest behind it. Blocked!

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Practise with a friend. Be brave, and get your body behind the ball!
